issues.title: Store/Display date/time for new perception
issues.body:
We will have the concept of `old` perception data - which is still better than nothing.

So, we should store the game-time when new perceptions are captured.

Then, we have the `option` of providing that to players (**and umpires**) within the game to help with planning and adjudication.

Update: this value is now being stored.  Add functionality to display it.  One place would be a `last known` date in the Planning asssets table.  Another could be in the hover popup
